title: The settled designs into the user documentation
author: Claude-JG
description: docs/dev/design/genericDAE.md, symbolicHT.md, symbolicSystem.md, symbolicUserItems.md and systemJacobians.md describe what is decided and implemented. Decided: what a user needs goes into the manual and the item descriptions, the design files are removed when nothing is left in them.
releaseNotes: The settled designs are in the manual, the item descriptions and the developer internals: ObjectGenericDAE, the homogeneous transformations, the system Jacobians, the symbolic system (docs/dev/internals/symbolicSystem.md, new) and the user items with the interfaces of the built-in items; the design files genericDAE.md, symbolicHT.md, systemJacobians.md, symbolicUserItems.md and itemPrecomputation.md are removed, symbolicSystem.md keeps the sections that other open designs cite; the docstrings cite no design file.
